probes.claim: Detect unintended document-level horizontal overflow at an exercised viewport.
probes.limitations: Does not prove local clipping, intended scrollers, or visual quality.

probes.claim: Exercise keyboard focus and detect missing or obscured focus on exercised controls.
probes.limitations: Cannot prove logical focus order for every workflow without scenario knowledge.

probes.claim: Exercise configured zoom or equivalent constrained CSS viewport and detect overflow/overlap assertions.
probes.limitations: Browser zoom semantics vary; retain environment metadata.

probes.claim: Exercise reduced-motion preference and assert configured motion invariants.
probes.limitations: Cannot judge whether remaining motion is cognitively appropriate.

probes.claim: Repeat a consequential action rapidly and verify domain operation cardinality and UI state.
probes.limitations: Requires application-specific observation of the domain effect.

probes.claim: Observe local, pending, persisted, rejected and conflicting transitions against authoritative persistence state.
probes.limitations: Requires an application adapter or test seam exposing authoritative state.

probes.claim: Interrupt connectivity, exercise recovery, and verify valid work and truthful status.
probes.limitations: Requires a workflow with a network dependency.

probes.claim: Expire authentication during work and verify safe recovery and permitted work preservation.
